The Nil Zone can copy vehicles too?!|audio = NullVoidNight3Wave15-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 15 ([[Blind Faith]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Pursuit''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Pursuit''', was a [[Flying]] enemy that appears in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had significantly higher health than the [[Null Shrieker]] that appeared before it. It has one ability, where it fires a barrage of missiles at towers and units. For towers, this applies a 25% [[Damage Debuff]], while to units, this deals 200 damage to them. ==Logbook Description== "''The Null Pursuit flew in, leaving Engineer in awe as it was piloted by two skeletal figures within. She spent ages perfecting that rotorcraft, and the Nil Zone copied every last detail down to the missiles it fired at her team. Once Engineer built another sentry in annoyance, she pulled out her notepad and wrote 'Add: Remote pilot ejection.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Pursuit''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Pursuit]]. The helicopter specifically is based on the RAH-66 Comanche helicopter used for the Level 5B of the Default [[Pursuit]] skin. It is a black and red helicopter mounted with autocannon and trapezoid missile pods, with Null shard decorations and two [[Skeleton]]s driving the helicopter. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers with flying detection, like the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are recommended here. **[[The Sun]] curse can be helpful here, as it can give every tower flying detection even if it does not have it. This includes towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] or [[Golden Minigunner]]. ***Alternatively, the [[Firework Technician]] can be used to temporarily give towers flying detection. *As the '''Null Pursuit''' debuffs towers, the [[Medic]] cannot be used to shield towers from its ability. **While the [[Medic]] cannot be used, the [[DJ Booth]] can be used to partially mitigate the effects of the debuff. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullPursuit.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NullPursuitIconIG.png|'''Null Pursuit''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Pursuit''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Null Pursuit''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Pursuit''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{BlindFaith|[[Null Warden]]|Wave 13|Null Pursuit|Wave 15|[[Null Electroshocker]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
